title: Doughill Forest Trail Walking Route

images.title: Forestry at Slieve Bawn - track junction above wind turbine No 19 by Colin Park, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: Forestry at Slieve Bawn. Doughill Forest is a tranquil woodland retreat situated near Killavackan and Bumlin in County Roscommon. It is considered a hidden gem within Ireland's "Hidden Heartlands," offering a peaceful escape from more crowded tourist destinations. The forest is located on Sliabh Bawn mountain, which features two main peaks reaching up to 262 metres and is home to the Sliabh Bawn Wind Farm.

images.title: Forestry at Slieve Bawn - Mass Rock by Colin Park, CC BY-SA 2.0 <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0>, via Wikimedia Commons
images.caption: The trails generally follow wide, steady forest roads and hard-packed gravel paths, making them suitable for hiking, running, and family outings. The forest environment includes a mix of tree species, such as water-tolerant alder and willow in wetter areas, alongside ferns, wood sorrel, and heather. Additional amenities developed alongside the wind farm include a trim trail for fitness, an equestrian trail, a raised viewing platform, and dedicated picnic areas

description: This walk follows the peaceful woodland trail in Doughill Forest near Killavackan and Strokestown in County Roscommon. There's miles of wide trails taking you around the slopes of Sliabh Bawn mountain. To continue your walking in the area you could head to the pretty Annaghmore Lough.
